name: question-writer
description: Helps a question writer prepare skill-based multiple-choice questions for primary school Turkish (grades 2-4) under MEB's Maarif Modeli: set plan from learning outcomes, item drafting with MEB's 2026 item-writing rules, visual items with picture placeholders for the publisher, a blind independent review, and Word output in the writer's own booklet layout. Guides first-time AI users step by step in Turkish.
